dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Ah, may the moonlight shine upon your path ahead! Are you here to seek the guidance of Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar, too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are Frostmoon Scions here as well?

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: That's right. Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar's grace should be known to all. I will go without hesitation, spreading her blessings far and wide — be it to the deepest abyss or the highest peak.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Even in a place like Nasha Town, I am sure there are still good people around. Like you, who have surely come to seek Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar's guidance... right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about Kuutar...

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar is the deity we Frostmoon Scions revere. Whatever we pray for, she answers. Whatever we seek, she guides us to find.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Because she is the merciful new moon, the successor of Frost Moon, and a god deserving of our praise. You should try praying to her too. Should your soul be pure enough, I'm sure she will respond to your pleas.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I've come down the wrong street, sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: I see. That's alright. Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar guides all souls, even those who merely pass through. I pray that your heart may find happiness and peace in this mortal world, bathed in moonlight.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where there are good people, you'll find bad ones too.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: That is true. Before coming to Nasha Town, I heard a lot of... unsavory rumors, but that's not the case. You and Mr. Kantor over there are both wonderful people!

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Speaking of Mr. Kantor... Every day, he comes to hear tales of the Frostmoon Scions, and he even helps me with chores in the shop. Such devotion moves the heart!
